Read-only survey compares root and all-association selectors.
Confirmed parameter/format unsupported response 0x2006/0x2014 for the association query permits a bounded all-object fallback.
Only GetObjectHandles/GetObjectInfo are exposed by the survey operations interface.
No GetObject content read, object upload, deletion, vendor operation or camera property write is added to the probe.
128 metadata requests per survey across selectors; maximum two available storages surveyed.
Counts above 4096 handles are validated and recorded as truncated without allocating a handle array or reading metadata.
Queries above the metadata limit are explicitly incomplete, not treated as empty directories.
60-second monotonic budget checked at operation boundaries; in-flight I/O still uses the transport timeout/cancellation.
Partial results, selector mismatches, original error codes and query parameters are preserved.
Unsupported or truncated queries cause top-level directoryInspectionStatus=partial.
The original upload logic is unchanged and is never automatically invoked by a survey.

Real-device evidence received from user:
0.1.3 upload experiment cannot find root NIKON through USB; no object writes attempted.
User confirms exported preset is visible in the camera's Copy to camera list.
This establishes an accessible preset on the SD card, not arbitrary USB file access.
0.1.4 is a diagnostic build, not a confirmed fix for uploading NCP or registering presets.
